messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed a mismatch between reservation R-4823 and the shipping manifest. Rack build for DC-east planned today 1600. Can owners confirm what actually shipped?

owen: I saw the same in the manifest. It lists 8x A100 + 4x A40 but the reservation is for 12x A100. Not sure if procurement substituted.

devon: Procurement pinged me last night, they flagged a partial backfill: shortage on A100s so vendor substituted A40s for 4 units. They said they'd log a change request but I don't see it in the reservation.

maya: Ugh. We need the reservation record to match before we do racking/PDUs. If we rack as-is we risk capacity mismatch for Dedicated profiles. Lia — do we have rack assignment flexibility?

lia: We can hold the physical racking until 2100 tonight. But shipping has already boxed units and they arrive in the morning. If we delay, shipping will have to re-route. Also cable kits: two orders show "missing" on the packing list (kits for 4 GPUs).

capacity-bot: Reservation R-4823 status: "ACTIVE" (12 slots). No amendment found. Linked PO: PO-99871. Last update: 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC.

shipping-bot: Shipping manifest 1387 https://ship.example.com/1387 — delivered to DC-east dock ETA 09:40. Tracking: TRK-5512. Packing notes: 4 units labelled A40-sku.

owen: Suggestion: we perform a soft-accept for the 8 A100s and place the 4 A40s into a holding pool. Then update reservation to reflect "8 A100 + 4 compatible A40 fallback" and adjust routing policy so that A40-backed capacity is only used for non-SLA tiers. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maya: Agree with soft-accept. But we need procurement to sign off on the fallback policy. Devon can you get PO amendment or an email thread logged?

devon: On it. I'll escalate to vendor and ask for an official amendment by EOD. If amendment not received, I'll open a supplier claim and request emergency procure for 4 A100s.

lia: For racking: I'll stage the 12 nodes together but label 4 as "fallback" and hook them to a separate power distribution we've reserved. That avoids accidental mix into Dedicated pools. Cable kits — I'll confirm which kits are missing and whether a temporary cable swap works.

maya: Perfect. Also pinging @owen for a quick runbook change — update the provisioning script to treat reservation R-4823 as mixed-sku. Add a fallback flag so autoscaler won't allocate to prod-critical. Example change:

```
# pseudo
assign_nodes --reservation R-4823 --primary-sku A100 --fallback-sku A40 --fallback-policy tier:non-prod
```

owen: Will do. I'll open a tiny PR with the change and a unit test. ETA 2h.

devon: Vendor replied; they can issue an amendment but it'll be a 24h turnaround. I'll attach the reply to the PO in procurement. If you want immediate parity, we need to approve emergency order.

maya: Let's proceed with the soft-accept + fallback policy now. Devon, include the vendor email in the reservation notes. Lia, hold racking until I confirm labels on arrival (should be ~09:50). Owen, I'll review your PR when it's up.

shipping-bot: Dock delivery confirmed at 09:47. Unloading in progress. Handler: S. Park.

lia: Unboxing started. I see two cable kits missing (CK-321/CK-322). I'm reusing spare kit CK-spare-02 for initial racking; procurement will need to replace spare later.

maya: Thanks team. We'll run a short canary on 8 A100s to validate model latency, and route non-critical traffic to A40s. If vendor amendment arrives, we'll flip reservation to 12x A100. Otherwise open emergency procure.

owen: PR done: #3245 — adds fallback flag and test. Small doc note in infra/playbooks/capacity.md.

devon: Procurement updated PO with vendor email link and amendment request. Tracking ticket TCK-780 opened for emergency order if needed.

maya: Closing loop: action items — Devon: vendor amendment or emergency PO (TCK-780). Lia: label & separate fallback nodes; note missing kits. Owen: merge PR and deploy. I'll run canary at 14:00. Thanks :thumbsup:
